Simple Past Tense
Adverbs of time, positive, negative & interrogative
Hi! I'm Blip! Let's learn about Simple Past Tense together. Pick the correct answer for each question! 🌟
Your Score
0 / 11
Progress
⏱ Adverb of Time

1. I went to school ___.

2. ___, I wrote an essay in class.

3. ___, I watched TV with my mother.

4. My father did not wash the car ___.

✅ Positive Sentence

5. I ___ my mother last Sunday.

6. They ___ this music two hours ago.

✅ Fill in the Blank

7. Bajuku kotor sehabis bermain bola. Zorp ___ (wash) clothes last Saturday.

8. Aku lagi suka menggambar. Yesterday, I ___ (paint) a view at school.

❌ Negative Sentence

9. I forgot to eat breakfast. He ___ breakfast today.

10. It was a rainy Sunday. My family ___ to the park last Sunday.

❓ Interrogative Sentence

11. Kemarin kasurnya tidak nyaman. ___ I sleep very well?

Irregular Verbs
Matching pairs & fill in the blanks
Hi! I'm Nano! Irregular verbs change their form completely — no -ed here! Match each verb to its past form! 💚
Your Score
0 / 20
Progress
🔗 Match the Irregular Verbs!

👆 Tap a word on the left, then tap its past tense on the right!

📝 Fill in the Blanks

1. I ___ a watermelon yesterday. (eat)

2. I ___ a zebra last week. (see)

3. My Father ___ me playing games yesterday. (catch)

4. My mother ___ me maths last night. (teach)

5. Yesterday, I ___ on the green grass. (fall)

6. My aunt ___ from Bandung last night. (come)

7. My mom ___ a pancake. (make)

8. Last week, I ___ my friend a gift because it was her birthday. (give)

🏆
Adventure Complete!
💬 Reflection Time!

1. What is the difference between a regular verb and an irregular verb? Give 2 examples of each!

2. Which irregular verb pair was the hardest to remember? How will you try to remember it?

3. Write 2 sentences about things you or your family did recently — use irregular verbs!
